location.title: Kalyves. The Crete people keep to themselves.
location.text: A genuine Cretan fishing village on the shores of Souda Bay, with sandy beaches, family tavernas and a lively promenade. Calm all year, never crowded, never staged. And just twelve minutes from the Venetian harbour of Chania.
location.flightsNote: Approximate flight times in hours. Seasonal and year-round connections vary by airline.
location.ferriesText: Crete is linked by daily ferries to Piraeus (Athens) and to the most popular islands of the Aegean.
